name: Banana bread
summary: A moist, golden loaf made from over-ripe bananas, sliced thick for breakfast on the run or a lunchbox treat, plain or spread with butter.
about: Banana bread is the bake that rescues the brown bananas in the fruit bowl. It is a one-bowl loaf children can help make, and a slice freezes well for school mornings.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C for a fan oven). Grease a 22 × 12 cm loaf tin and line the base and long sides with baking paper.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl with a fork until mostly smooth, with a few small lumps.
Whisk in the melted butter, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk until well combined.
Sift the flour, bicarbonate of soda, baking powder, cinnamon and salt over the banana mixture and fold together with a spatula until no dry flour remains. Do not overmix; a few lumps are fine.

Scrape the batter into the tin, smooth the top and bake for 55–60 minutes, until risen, deep golden and a skewer pushed into the centre comes out clean. If the top browns too fast, cover it loosely with foil for the last 15 minutes.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift out onto a rack and cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing into 10 thick slices.
prepNote: Keeps 3 days wrapped at room temperature. Freeze slices separately and toast or thaw them for school mornings.
